newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran says $100 million gas project completed.
newsitem.headline: Iran says $100 million gas project completed.

text.p: A $100 million gas injection project in southwestern Iran has been completed and will go onstream soon, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Tuesday.

It said the Bibi Hakimeh project, built in six years for 175 billion rials ($100 million) in Kohkilouyeh-Boyer Ahmad province, would boost output by more than a billion barrels at an adjoining oil field. It did not say when the gas injection scheme would be commissioned.
The project would also save 150 million cubic feet of natural gas per day which is being burnt now, the agency added.
($1=1,750 rials at the rate used for state budget accounts)
